label: Aquinas I q.19 a.10 bears on the POWER_OVER_ESSE_1 bridge
note: The divine case supplies voluntary alternatives regarding a thing’s existence. The antecedent needs a correspondence between effective willing and the same giver’s indexed giving or withholding across the selected accessible worlds. The conclusion PowerOver y x esse additionally requires that the effect’s continued being depend on that giver’s continued exercise, so a different giver could not sustain the effect despite the selected giver’s withdrawal. I q.104 a.3 bears on that dependence for divine conservation in the offline translation. The admitted witnesses do not cover that article.
